name: vibration-reduction pad floating slab
definition_zh: 以减振垫支承浮置板实现隔振的轨道结构。
usage_overview: 用于降低轨道振动向隧道的传递，通过道床板下的减振垫提供弹性支承，利用这一支承层实现浮置板的隔振作用。

complete_examples.text: In this paper, a certain section of a city railway track with vibration-reduction pad floating slab was taken as the research object.
Therefore, achieving low dynamic design of the vibration-reduction pad floating slab system through appropriate parameter matching is particularly important.
